name: claims_os_telegram_conversations
purpose: TEL-002B1 persistent non-financial Telegram conversation state
setup: Create this table once in n8n Data Tables, then set TEL-002B1 workflow Data Table nodes to this table ID. The workflow processes one allowed chat and rejects update_id values at or below lastUpdateId. Data Table upsert is not treated as a financial lock; TEL-001 remains the authoritative transaction/idempotency layer.
